validity.researcher_notes: SHEET'S OWN SOURCES: the gem.wiki page cites only two OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletins (ASB2012 p.75, ASB2017 p.136). I ran url_verifier on ASB2017 -> 200 but the document does NOT contain 'Abqaiq' or 'Shedgum'; these are country-level petroleum statistics, not a pipeline reference. So the sheet has zero source that names this pipeline. INDEPENDENT SEARCH: multiple web searches (EN) for an Abqaiq-Shedgum 42-inch 53 km gas line return only the gem.wiki page and search-engine restatements of GEM's own numbers (circular, GEM-derived, excluded). GulfPub PE World Map SA gas roster (20 features) has NO Abqaiq-Shedgum gas line (it has 'Abqaiq - Qatif' 16in/14km and 'East-West Gas Pipeline | Abqaiq/Shedgum fields -> Yanbu'); it does not corroborate this entity. GEOGRAPHY IS PLAUSIBLE BUT NOT THE ENTITY: Shedgum Gas Plant is real (on stream 1980, Aramco, ~25.652N 49.391E; confirmed via Fluor project page and Saudipedia) and Abqaiq/Buqayq is a real major Aramco gas-separation/oil-processing hub ~40-50 km NE; a gas interconnect between them is physically believable, which is exactly why a GIS-extracted segment would look reasonable. But plausible geography is not evidence the specific named pipeline exists with these specs. DUPLICATE CHECK: not a clear 1:1 duplicate of another roster PID (P1924 Aindar-Shedgum is a different Ghawar area at 34km/12in; P3962 East-West is the 1200km/48in MGS trunk to Yanbu), but it may be a synthetic sub-segment of the Shedgum-area gas gathering / MGS system rather than a standalone line. CLASSIFICATION/ATTRIBUTION: Gas + Saudi Aramco 100% are generically correct for any SA domestic gas asset, but cannot be independently confirmed for THIS entity since no source names it. CONCLUSION: existence unverifiable from any non-GEM source; flag rather than pass.
